meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 命令行工具的安装状态,找出过期、走样或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 Codex 安装后行为异常,想确认本地环境是否需要更新或修复
copy.tagline_en: Health-check your Codex CLI install and flag stale, drifted, or broken setups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if Codex acts up after an install or update and you want your local setup audited

howto.what: 它会检查本地 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装状态,与最新源码逐项比对,输出每条结论都引用命令输出或文件证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告并给修复建议;只诊断,不改动你的安装、配置或仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 LazyCodex 等名称,或 Codex 在安装、更新、改配置后行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 安装是否健康
say.note: 输出带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告。

say.text: Codex 上次更新后就不太对劲,查一下
say.note: 逐项比对本地与最新源码的差异。

say.text: 看看我这套环境能不能跑 gpt-6-astra
say.note: 检查 Astra 就绪状态并给结论。

howto.what_en: It inspects your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install, compares it against the latest sources, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report citing evidence for each verdict. It only diagnoses and suggests fixes, never editing your install, config, or repos.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex or similar names, or Codex acts oddly after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run a health check on my LazyCodex install
say_en.note: Prints a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence.

say_en.text: Codex has been weird since the last update - check it
say_en.note: Compares local files against the latest sources.
